figurative_meaning_en: at an extremely high speed; with intense velocity, very quickly
example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃষ্টি শুরু হওয়ার সাথে সাথে সবাই ঊর্ধ্বশ্বাসে বাড়ি ফিরল।
example_sentences_in_english: He ran away at breakneck speed.
As soon as the rain started, everyone hurried home at full speed.
note: This idiom evokes the image of someone running so fast that their breath is directed upwards, implying exhaustion from speed.
